description: Deterministically resolve a folder, list eligible (CONVERTED) videos, estimate the AI subtitle cost in credits, and optionally generate subtitles in one or more languages. Tiers: essential (only en/pt-BR/es, 1 credit/30min), advanced (34 langs, 1 credit/5min), pro (34 langs, 1 credit/min). dry_run=true (default) returns a preview.

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

idempotency_key.description: Reserved client-supplied key to make retries safe (not yet enforced server-side)

target_langs.description: Subtitle language codes to generate, e.g. ['en','es']

tier.description: Quality tier (essential restricts languages to en/pt-BR/es)

name: panda_action_generate_subtitles_for_folder
title: Generate Subtitles for Folder
